svg.text: 1. Use the SoC pin names as the OLDI signal name
2. Change C128, C129 to 10pF and set C261 and C265 as DNP to match the crystal
3. Add Testpoint to VDD_3V3 and VDD_1V0
4. Remove eMMC_RSTn to fix the eMMC reboot issue and the system doesn't power on with HDMI issue. #67 #63
5. DNP R176 to set to FS boot mode. #60
6. Modify SPE PHY address to prevent conflict to GBE. #64
7. Change Jtag pullup power to VDD_1V8. #62
8. Change SD card cage to PocketBeagle type. #58
11. Move GBE_RSTn to BOOTMODE0 to prevent conflict.
14. Change Wifi module to M.2 1216 WiFi6 module.
15. Update Sytem block diagram and power tree diagram.
1. Change HDMI bridge to 24bit RGB mode. #77
3. HDMI framer updated from Sil9022 to IT6612. #79
6. SPE Output power switch updated to TPS25200 which has adjastable current limits.
1. Change WiFi Module back to WL1807.
2. EEPROM set default to be write-protect enabled.
7. Add pulldown resistor to disable PoDL by default.
